rationale: The platform requires a clean, authoritative, and functional developer portal that aligns with the existing PFP brand (blue-600, white background, slate neutrals). The Swiss & High-Contrast archetype ensures maximum legibility for documentation and code blocks.

layout.structure: Stripe/Twilio inspired single-page documentation structure with vertical flow. Sticky header, Hero Section, Content Body with Left Sticky Nav (if multi-page) or single unified vertical scroll.
layout.header: Sticky header with glassmorphism `bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 z-50`. Include Logo (ShieldCheck in blue square), Nav links (Demo, Admin), and primary CTA.
layout.hero: Technical and spacious hero section. Uses a subtle CSS grid background for texture. Center-aligned text for the main hook, immediately followed by Get Started onboarding flow.

cards.style: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-sm transition-all duration-200
cards.content: Use Space Grotesk for card titles. Feature a lucide-react icon with a blue-50 background and blue-600 text as the focal point of the card.

code_blocks.style: bg-slate-950 rounded-xl p-4 md:p-6 overflow-x-auto relative border border-slate-800 shadow-inner mt-4
code_blocks.features: Must include a copy button in the top right corner (`absolute top-3 right-3 text-slate-400 hover:text-white`). Use basic manual syntax highlighting (e.g. coloring keywords blue/pink using spans) if actual syntax highlighter library is not available.

status_pills.style: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium ring-1 ring-inset
status_pills.indicator: For 'Live' or 'Active' statuses, prepend a small 6px rounded-full dot with a `animate-pulse` class.

step_indicator.style: w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200
step_indicator.connector: Vertical line connecting steps using `absolute left-4 top-8 bottom-[-2rem] w-[2px] bg-slate-200`.

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700 font-medium rounded-lg px-4 py-2 transition-colors inline-flex items-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 font-medium rounded-lg px-4 py-2 transition-colors inline-flex items-center gap-2
buttons.outline: text-blue-600 border border-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-50 font-medium rounded-lg px-4 py-2 transition-colors inline-flex items-center gap-2

motion.hover: Subtle translate-y (`-translate-y-0.5`) on resource cards. Smooth color transitions (`transition-all duration-200`).
motion.entrance: If using Framer Motion, use staggered fade-up for Get Started steps. Otherwise, rely on clean static presentation.

icons.usage: Use consistently for cards, navigation, and buttons. Primary brand mark is `ShieldCheck`. Other technical icons: `Code`, `FileText`, `Terminal`, `Key`, `Activity`, `Download`, `BookOpen`.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Implement the Developer Portal at the route `/developers` in the existing App component (React Router). Create a new page component.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Create a sticky header with navigation linking to /api/docs, /api/redoc, /api/openapi.json, and the Admin/Demo portals. Ensure it uses `bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md z-50`.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Build the Hero section with a subtle CSS grid background (use the `decorative_grid` style from these guidelines). Keep it spacious and enterprise-grade.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Implement the 'First API Call in 15 Minutes' 5-step onboarding path using the `step_indicator` style and dark `code_blocks`. Ensure snippets are copyable.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Create the Resource Cards grid (Swagger UI, ReDoc, OpenAPI JSON, API Ref, Auth Guide, Quick Start, Architecture). Ensure they have the hover lift and shadow.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Add the SDK Download Section with 4 language cards (Python, JavaScript, Java, .NET) and Postman Collection download.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Add the Platform Status section with live pills using the `status_pills` style. Ensure they have the correct colors.
instructions_to_main_agent.8: All interactive elements must have a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case.
